name: identity-workforce-access
objective: Make Captain authentication, role/surface authorization, Workforce readiness and operator Captain lifecycle one consistent fail-closed access path.
truthOwner: Identity authenticates; Workforce owns Captain profile/readiness; DSH consumes authorized actor context but does not replace those truths.

tasks.currentProblem: App.tsx already composes IdentitySessionGate and WorkforceAccessGate, but static composition does not prove backend profile provisioning, status transitions, role/surface enforcement, refresh/restart behavior or isolation.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace HR Captain create/detail through Identity/Workforce persistence and app-captain readiness; fix only mismatches that allow missing/suspended/wrong-role actors through or leave valid Captains blocked.
tasks.targetState: A Captain can enter only with a valid captain role, app-captain surface authorization and allowed Workforce state; denied states remain explicit after refresh/restart.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not store Workforce truth in app-captain.
Do not bypass role/surface checks with a developer-only production path.
Do not broaden generic HR employee/field flows unless shared code is directly affected.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing/unprovisioned/suspended/wrong-role Captain fails closed with actionable state.
Valid Captain readiness is read from authoritative backend state, not a local flag.
Control-panel Captain lifecycle and app readback converge on the same actor/profile identity.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data/evidence; never restore a parallel source of truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U002 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.

tasks.currentProblem: SecureStore session, device fingerprint and push registration are composed in runtime but need negative evidence around logout/restart/actor changes.
tasks.requiredChange: Ensure session restoration, device identity and push registration cannot cross Captain actors and are invalidated/rebound when identity changes.
tasks.targetState: No stale actor token, device binding or push registration can authorize or address another Captain.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not log tokens or sensitive device identifiers.
Do not make device fingerprint an authorization source.
Do not weaken server-side trusted-context authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: Logout/relogin cannot retain another Captain's protected readback.
Push registration is actor/surface scoped and revocable.
Server authorization remains authoritative regardless of device-local state.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data/evidence; never restore a parallel source of truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U002 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.
